events.description:
Called with each finished recording. While a returned promise runs the input shows "Processing", for example
while the app transcribes; a rejection shows the error state.
events.name: onRecord

events.description: Called each time the state changes.
events.name: onStateChange

props.description: The recorder. Defaults to the MediaRecorder driver on web and the mock driver on native.
props.name: recorder

props.description: The button's name while idle. Defaults to the catalogue's "Start recording".
props.name: label

props.description: False to hide the status line beside the button (it is still announced). Defaults to true.
props.name: isStatusVisible

props.description: True to show the button but refuse presses.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: Styles the row that holds the button, the level and the status.
props.name: className
